---
title: "_{{this_species_name}}_"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(effectclass)
library(git2rdata)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(leaflet)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::pull, dplyr::filter)
threshold <- log(0.75)
if (interactive()) {
  keyring::key_get("meetnetten", username = "watervogels_result") |>
    file.path("data") -> root
  read_vc("analysis", root = root) |>
    filter(!is.na(as.integer(.data$species))) |>
    distinct() |>
    count(.data$locationgroup, .data$species) |>
    slice_max(.data$n, n = 1) |>
    slice_sample(n = 1) -> tmp
  spec <- tmp$species
} else {
  root <- file.path("..", "..", "..", "data")
  spec <- "{{species}}"
}
```

```{r read-data}
read_vc("analysis", root = root) -> analysis
read_vc("locationgroup", root = root) |>
  transmute(
    .data$external_code,
    locationgroup = str_replace(.data$description, "België", "Belgium") |>
      str_replace("Wallonië", "Wallonia-Brussels") |>
      str_replace("Vlaanderen", "Flanders")
  ) -> locationgroup
dirs <- list.dirs(root, full.names = FALSE)
dirs <- dirs[basename(dirs) == spec]
dirs <- dirs[!grepl("model_check", dirs)]
map_dfr(
  dirs,
  function(x) {
    fn <- file.path(x, "trend")
    if (is_git2rdata(file = fn, root = root)) {
      return(read_vc(fn, root = root))
    }
    data.frame()
  }
) |>
  inner_join(
    analysis |>
      filter(str_detect(.data$model_type, "Month")) |>
      select("analysis", external_code = "locationgroup"),
    by = "analysis"
  ) |>
  inner_join(locationgroup, by = "external_code") |>
  group_by(.data$locationgroup, .data$duration) |>
  slice_max(.data$centre_winter, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    url = tolower(.data$locationgroup) |>
      str_replace_all(" ", "-") |>
      sprintf(fmt = "%s.html"),
    classification = classification(
      lcl = .data$duration * .data$lcl, ucl = .data$duration * .data$ucl,
      threshold = threshold
    ),
    when = sprintf(
      "%.0f--%.0f", .data$centre_winter - .data$duration / 2 + 0.5,
      .data$centre_winter + .data$duration / 2 - 0.5
    ),
    yearly_change = format_ci(
      .data$estimate, lcl = .data$lcl, change = TRUE,
      ucl = .data$ucl, link = "log", percent = TRUE
    ) |>
      sprintf(fmt = "%1$s %2$s", .data$classification)
  ) -> trends
trends |>
  group_by(.data$locationgroup) |>
  slice_min(.data$duration, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(.data$classification, desc(.data$estimate)) |>
  pull(.data$locationgroup) -> loc_lab
trends <- trends |>
  mutate(locationgroup = factor(.data$locationgroup, levels = loc_lab))
```

```{r vernacular}
read_vc(file = "species", root = root) |>
  filter(.data$euring == as.integer(spec)) -> species
year_range <- c(1992, 2024)
c(
  srs = "EPSG:3857", taxonKey = species$gbif, bin = "hex", hexPerTile = 20,
  style = "orange.marker", years = paste(year_range, collapse = ",")
) %>%
  paste(names(.), ., sep = "=", collapse = "&") |>
  c(
    "https://api.gbif.org/v2/map/occurrence/density/{z}/{x}/{y}@2x.png"
  ) |>
  rev() |>
  paste(collapse = "?") -> url
read_vc(file = "vernacular", root = root) |>
  filter(.data$euring == as.integer(spec)) |>
  mutate(
    language = factor(
      .data$language, levels = c("eng", "nld", "fra", "deu"),
      labels = c("English", "Nederlands", "Français", "Deutsch")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(.data$language) |>
  group_by(.data$euring) |>
  summarise(
    markdown = sprintf("- **%s**: %s", .data$language, .data$vernacular) |>
      paste(collapse = "\n")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    markdown = sprintf(
      "- EURING code %i\n%s

More information on [GBIF](https://www.gbif.org/species/%s){target=\"_blank\"}",
      .data$euring, .data$markdown, species$gbif
    )
  ) |>
  pull(.data$markdown) -> vernacular
```

`r vernacular`

```{r fig-map}
#| fig-cap: "Map of _{{this_species_name}}_ on GBIF"
leaflet() |>
  setView(4.37, 50.85, zoom = 7) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addTiles(urlTemplate = url)
```

```{r tbl-linear-trend}
#| tbl-cap: "Overview of linear trends for _{{this_species_name}}_"
bg_colour <- c(effectclass:::detailed_signed_palette, "NA" = "white")
trends |>
  transmute(.data$url, .data$locationgroup, .data$when, classification = as.character(.data$classification)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from  = "when", values_from = "classification", values_fill = "NA") |>
  arrange(.data$locationgroup) -> classif
trends |>
  select("locationgroup", "when", "yearly_change") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from  = "when", values_from = "yearly_change", values_fill = "") |>
  arrange(.data$locationgroup) |>
  kable(align = "lccc") |>
  kable_paper(c("hover", "striped", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(position = "center") |>
  column_spec(1, link = classif$url) -> this_table
for (i in 3:ncol(classif)) {
  this_table <- this_table |>
    column_spec(i - 1, color = "white", background = bg_colour[classif[[i]]])
}
this_table
```
